title_en: Embeddings, retrieval, RAG and guarded agents
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: الـembedding بيحوّل النص لموضع، والمواضع القريبة معناها حاجات متشابهة.
sentences.en: An embedding turns text into a position, and nearby positions mean similar things.

sentences.ar: ودي الحكاية كلها ورا الـsemantic search: الـkeyword search بيطابق نصوص، والـembeddings بتطابق معنى، والـcosine similarity هي إزاي تسأل مين الأقرب.
sentences.en: That is the whole trick behind semantic search: keyword search matches strings, embeddings match meaning, and cosine similarity is how you ask which is nearest.

sentences.ar: والـRAG عبارة عن pipeline، وكل مرحلة فيها ممكن تفشل لوحدها.
sentences.en: Retrieval-augmented generation is a pipeline, and every stage can fail on its own.

sentences.ar: المستندات بتتقسّم chunks. والـchunks بتتعمل لها embedding وindex.
sentences.en: Documents are split into chunks; chunks are embedded and indexed.

sentences.ar: والـquery بترجّع مرشحين. وفلتر الصلاحيات بيشيل اللي المستخدم ده مش مسموح له يشوفه.
sentences.en: A query retrieves candidates; an access filter removes what this user may not see.

sentences.ar: والـreranker بيعيد الترتيب. واللي فضل بيبقى الـcontext.
sentences.en: A reranker reorders; the survivors become context.

sentences.ar: والنموذج بيجاوب، ومعاه مصادر.
sentences.en: The model answers, with citations.

sentences.ar: وأهو failure مقيس مش مدّعى.
sentences.en: And here is a measured failure rather than a claimed one.

sentences.ar: اسأل إزاي أمنع job إنها تحمّل نفس الصفوف مرتين.
sentences.en: Ask how do I stop a job loading the same rows twice.

sentences.ar: أعلى نتيجة قسم roadmap بدرجة صفر فاصل واحد ستة خمسة واثق وغلط وضعيف.
sentences.en: The top hit is a roadmap section scoring zero point one six five — confident, wrong and weak.

sentences.ar: وسّع الـquery بمرادفات وقسم الـidempotency يطلع لصفر فاصل اتنين اتنين سبعة وياخد المركز الأول.
sentences.en: Expand the query with synonyms and the idempotency section climbs to zero point two two seven and takes the top slot.

sentences.ar: ده الـvocabulary mismatch، وده سبب إن أغلب فشل الـRAG هو فشل retrieval مش فشل generation.
sentences.en: That is vocabulary mismatch, and it is why most RAG failures are retrieval failures, not generation failures.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الجملة الأمنية اللي تستاهل تتحفظ: الاسترجاع query، مش إذن.
sentences.en: Now the security sentence worth memorising: retrieval is a query, not a permission.

sentences.ar: الـchunk ممكن يكون مثالي دلالياً وبرضه حاجة المستخدم ده المفروض عمره ما يشوفها، فالفلتر مكانه عند طبقة الاسترجاع
sentences.en: A chunk can be semantically perfect and still be something this user must never see, so the filter belongs at the retrieval layer —

sentences.ar: قبل النموذج مش بعده، لأن أول ما النص يدخل الـcontext window يبقى تسرّب خلاص.
sentences.en: before the model, not after it, because once text is in the context window it has already leaked.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً الـagents. الـagent مش chatbot أطول.
sentences.en: Finally, agents: an agent is not a longer chatbot.

sentences.ar: ده loop: هدف، وstate، وأداة متختارة، وملاحظة، وstate متحدّثة، وشرط توقف.
sentences.en: It is a loop: a goal, a state, a tool chosen, an observation, an updated state, and a stop condition.

sentences.ar: وكل خطوة خطرة بتعدّي على policy check الأول.
sentences.en: Every dangerous step passes a policy check first.

sentences.ar: بصّ على DELETE متولّد وهو بيقابل allowlist بترفض نوع الجملة، وبعدها دور database للقراءة فقط كان هيرفضها برضه.
sentences.en: Watch a generated DELETE meet an allowlist that rejects the statement type, and then a read-only database role that would have rejected it anyway.

sentences.ar: طبقتين مستقلتين، لأن الواحدة وعد والاتنين تصميم.
sentences.en: Two independent layers, because one is a promise and two is a design.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: Without expansion the top hit is a roadmap section at 0.165 — confident, wrong, weak.
With synonym expansion the idempotency section jumps to 0.227 and takes the top slot.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

حجم السياق اللي الـmodel شايفه مرة واحدة

concepts.def_en: A vector of numbers that represents text (or another item) so that similar meanings land at nearby positions.
concepts.def_ar: vector من أرقام بيمثّل النص، بحيث المعاني المتشابهة تبقى في أماكن قريبة من بعض.
concepts.failure: Assuming embeddings match exact keywords; they miss codes and product names that keyword search finds.

concepts.def_en: A score for how closely two vectors point in the same direction, ignoring their length; used to compare embeddings by meaning.
concepts.def_ar: الـcosine similarity مقياس قد إيه vectors اتنين اتجاههم قريب من بعض بغض النظر عن الطول؛ بنقارن بيه الـembeddings بالمعنى.
concepts.failure: Treating a high similarity score as proof the retrieved text is correct.

concepts.def_en: A chain of automated steps where each stage's output feeds the next, such as extract, tra…
concepts.failure: Not making steps idempotent, so a rerun duplicates or corrupts data.

concepts.def_en: A separate sorted lookup structure on one or more columns that lets a database find rows…
concepts.failure: Adding an index on every column; each one slows writes and may never be used.

concepts.def_en: A request to a database or search system to fetch, filter or change data; in SQL, usually…
concepts.failure: Blaming hardware for a slow query when a full table scan is the cause.

concepts.def_en: A second-stage model that rescores and reorders the retrieved candidates by relevance to the query so only the best become context.
concepts.def_ar: model في المرحلة التانية بيعيد تقييم المرشحين اللي اترجعوا ويرتّبهم حسب صلتهم بالـquery، والأفضل بس هو اللي يبقى context.
concepts.failure: Expecting reranking to recover documents the first-stage retrieval never returned.

concepts.def_en: Running an operation or request again gives the same result as running it once, so a stop…
concepts.failure: Rerunning a plain INSERT load after failure and silently duplicating the data.

concepts.def_en: Finding and returning the most relevant documents or chunks for a query, using keyword, v…
concepts.failure: Blaming the LLM for wrong answers when retrieval returned the wrong passages.

concepts.def_en: A passage cut from a document, small enough to embed, index and retrieve alone, carrying metadata about its source.
concepts.def_ar: قطعة من مستند، صغيرة كفاية عشان تتعمل embed وindex وتتسترجع لوحدها، ومعاها metadata عن مصدرها.
concepts.failure: Cutting chunks at fixed sizes without overlap or metadata, splitting answers across pieces.

concepts.def_en: The maximum number of tokens a model can see at once, covering the prompt, retrieved cont…
concepts.failure: Assuming filtering can wait; once data enters the window, the model has already seen it.

concepts.def_en: A construct that repeats a block of code for each item or until a condition changes.
concepts.failure: Off-by-one bounds, or a condition that never changes, looping forever.

concepts.def_en: A list of explicitly permitted items, such as SQL statement types or hosts; anything not on it is rejected by default.
concepts.def_ar: الـallowlist قايمة بالحاجات المسموحة صراحةً، زي أنواع SQL statements أو hosts؛ أي حاجة مش فيها بتترفض تلقائيًا.
concepts.failure: Using a blocklist of known bad items; anything unexpected still gets through.

metaphors.metaphor: **Vector galaxy**: meaning as position; query probe; nearest neighbours ignite (cosine); a document **shatters into chunks**; top-k pulled from thousands; reranker conveyor; **context tunnel** with a limit, where middle chunks fade (lost in the middle); "retrieval is a query, not permission" access gate; agent loop inside **two guard rings**
metaphors.failure_fix: Hallucination = red corrupted branch → grounding with citations; vocabulary mismatch → hybrid search

metaphors.failure_fix: Wrong grain double-counts → grain stamp fixes it

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
An embedding galaxy of seeded clusters (<= 1,500 points); a query probe finds nearest neighbours.
A target shatters into seeded blocks.
A context window as a tunnel; items enter and the oldest are evicted on overflow.
An agent loop (plan -> act -> observe) with guard checkpoints that can block a step.
A SQL query split into its logical execution stages, lit in execution order.
Rows narrowing through query stages (FROM -> WHERE -> GROUP BY -> HAVING -> ...).
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
